card.name: End of a drug name in interaction warnings
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug's full product name (salt or dosage-form part) in a sentence about concomitant use or warnings. It fires just before words like 'and', 'tablets' or 'injection'.

modes.label: Salt ending
modes.description: The final part of a salt name such as bitartrate, citrate or tartrate, right where the name ends.

modes.label: Inside long product names
modes.description: A middle or closing piece of a longer drug product name, such as a comma or 'for' after 'Injection'.
